messages:
maya: Quick q: for /v3/generate, when model returns validation error (input has unsupported param) should we return 4xx (422) or 400? And for midstream token generation failures (OOM on GPU) do we return 5xx with partial output or 200 with error envelope? We're trying to settle API contract for v3 before code freeze. cc @jordan @lia

jordan: Prefer 422 for semantic validation (unsupported param/value) so clients know not to retry. 400 reserved for malformed JSON. 429 for rate limit. For OOM -> 500 with `retryable: true`. Avoid returning 200+error payload for failures.

lia: Agree. For streaming: if a midstream failure occurs, emit an `:error` event (with error envelope) then close stream with a 5xx status. Clients should treat that as retryable depending on `error.retryable`.

maya: Example error envelope proposal:

`{
  "error": {
    "code": "validation_error",
    "http": 422,
    "message": "prompt exceeds model context",
    "retryable": false,
    "details": { "field": "prompt", "max_context": 8192 }
  }
}`

sam: SGTM. Small nit: prefer `error.code` (machine) + `error.message` (human). Add optional `hint` and `suggested_alternatives` array for auto-fix.

deploybot: deploybot: Canary for api-service v3 starts in 30m. Rollback window 45m. Will notify on failures :rocket:

jordan: Edge case: `max_tokens` > model capacity — treat as 4xx (validation). If server can transparently adapt, we can surface a `suggested_alternatives` list instead of guessing.

lia: Right. `suggested_alternatives` example: ["use smaller max_tokens","switch to model-x-16k"] — SDKs can surface this to users.

maya: I'll update the spec PR with the envelope + streaming guidance. Please review. @ryan can you scan for SDK compatibility?

ryan: I can review in ~2h. Note: SDKs currently expect `error.message` at top-level; keep that stable. Add unit tests asserting `error.retryable` is present for all server errors.

sam: Also add migration note: gateway will map legacy 400/500 to new shapes for 30 days to reduce client breakage.

jordan: TL;DR: 400 = parse, 422 = semantic validation, 429 = rate-limits, 5xx = infra/transient. Streaming -> send error event + close 5xx. Include `error.code`, `error.retryable`, and optional `suggested_alternatives`. Agreed? :+1:

maya: :thumbsup: will push PR and ping when ready.
